extends.description: Relative paths of the templates it extends, in order of application

years.description: Start year (required) / end year (null if still in production)

market.description: Target markets: EU, US, JP, etc.

parts.description: Part catalog. Entries merge by id with the parents. Whether an entry is new or an override is determined during resolution, so required fields for new parts (name or oem_number) are validated after merge at application level. IDs must be unique within this array; also validated by the resolver.

id.description: Part ID. If it already exists in the parent, it replaces it. Otherwise, it is added.

name.description: Part name. Only needed if it is a new part (not inherited); validated after merge.

i18n_key.description: Translation key for the name, e.g.: part_oil_filter

user_reference.description: User's preferred reference (local layer), overrides oem_number

remove.description: true → removes this part from the parent

maintenance_items.description: Maintenance tasks. Entries merge by id with the parents. New items must define interval_km (validated after merge at application level). IDs must be unique within this array; also validated by the resolver.

id.description: Item ID. If it already exists in the parent, it replaces it. Otherwise, it is added.

label.description: Only needed if it is a new item (not inherited). If it is a replace, the parent's label is used.

i18n_key.description: Translation key for the label, e.g.: seed_interval_oil_change

desc_i18n_key.description: Translation key for the description, e.g.: seed_desc_oil_change

parts.description: Parts needed for this task, referenced by part_id

obd_codes.description: OBD-II (DTC) codes related to this task

remove.description: true → removes this item from the parent (useful when a model does not have a generic task)

obd_dtc_definitions.description: Fault codes for this model or powertrain. Entries merge by code with the parents; entries that only override inherited fields may omit description/desc_i18n_key. Codes must be unique within this array; also validated by the resolver.

scope.description: standard → generic SAE code (P0xxx); manufacturer → manufacturer-specific code (P1xxx, P0Axx, etc.)

description.description: Only needed if it is a new code (not inherited); validated after merge.

desc_i18n_key.description: Translation key for the description, e.g.: dtc_p0171

related_maintenance.description: Suggested maintenance_item IDs to resolve the code

related_parts.description: Suggested part IDs to resolve the code

remove.description: true → removes this code from the parent
